gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads with a sizable, open feel on screen. Line after line, its curved letters keep their mouths unclosed, while Metamorphous above adds soft modulation like hand-drawn ink.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-sundane: Tall-waisted and stately up top, Metamorphous spaces its letters widely and shades its strokes in medium-range swings. Noto Sans Sundanese sits beneath it, low in contrast, with open-mouthed e crossbars.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Contemporary first: Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified without growing. Metamorphous does its best work in lightly modulated, commanding lines, while the body quietly keeps terminals far from the stem.

gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-thai: A lightly shaded texture runs through every word of Metamorphous, thanks to its soft step from fat strokes to slim ones. Noto Sans Thai, round and bead-like, is the approachable counterweight.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-thai-lo: Metamorphous sets a commanding tone with wide sidebearings and a high midline, its curves thickening gently at the shoulders. Noto Sans Thai Looped reads clean and sturdy, with spacious curve gaps.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Stately display lettering on top, with a sturdy, open body beneath it. Metamorphous adds moderate stroke contrast and a high midline, while Noto Sans Tirhuta leaves big gaps at its cut-back terminals.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-vai: Approachable, mostly: Noto Sans Vai forms solid word blocks. Their best quality is range: Metamorphous shifts weight gently in its bowls, while Noto Sans Vai leaves space at curve ends.
